maddeler.e:
اقلعففن (form IVq)
# اِقْلَعْفَفْنَ (iqlaʕfafna) /iq.laʕ.faf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# اُقْلُعْفِفْنَ (uqluʕfifna) /uq.luʕ.fif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# اِقْلَعْفِفْنَ (iqlaʕfifna) /iq.laʕ.fif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
